resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1914 per two sites; the 1915 annual report line lists a cabin under this name. Treated as built 1914, with the 1915 listing noted.

notes_for_editor: Fate unresolved: destroyed 1972 on firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com; removed, undated, on Forest Lookouts. One search found no description of the site today. idahofirelookouts.com gives elevation 5036 ft for this CTPA tower (no schema key for it). A reader comment on that page says the commenter staffed a Bald Mountain for the Idaho Dept. of Lands in 1987 or 1988. That conflicts with the 1972 destruction, probably refers to another Bald Mountain, and is not used. The record's 2005 event looks misattached (see corrections).
